title: One of the best chef knives on the market today!
text: One of the best chef knives on the market today!. I love to cook and I am always in the market for knives. This Wallop Damascus Santoku Knife is just perfect. For under $80 (which was the price when I was reviewing this), this knife is as good as the multi-hundred dollar+ competitor knives. First, it a perfect fit in my hand which allows me to maneuver the knife around my vegetables smoothly and flawlessly. Second, it is super sharp and slices through tomatoes and onions flawlessly. I can honestly say this is one of the finest chef knives I have ever used and I highly recommend this knife for anyone who loves to prepare and cook. This also makes a great gift with it's attractive packaging and would be a wonderful, thoughtful, shower, wedding or homeowner present for the person you love!

product_metadata.title: WALLOP Damascus Santoku Knife 7.5 inch - Kitchen Chef Knife with Japanese High Carbon Stainless Steel, Unique Solar Pattern Blade & Full Tang Ergonomic G10 Handle
features: √【Premium Santoku Knife】 WALLOP Damascus 7.5 inch santoku knife can easily handle your daily kitchen tasks of cutting, slicing, dicing and mincing fruits, vegetables, meats, and cheeses, providing long lasting cutting performance.

√【Razor Sharp Blade】 Ultra sharp edge of 12-15 degree per side are for precision control in kitchen. Engineered to perfection at 56+ Rockwell hardness and hand polished to a satin finish. Tall blade height provides useful knuckle clearance.

√【Japanese Damascus Stainless Steel】 Dragon Bone S series knives are made of durable Japanese High Carbon AUS-8 Super steel, ensuring this sharp santoku knife with outstanding rustproof and wear-resistance. It is also with nice Dragon and Solar blade surface pattern.

√【Ergonomic G10 Handle】 Equipped with hand-polished ergonomic G10 Handle, this knife will give you a better comfort feeling with agility. Never tired due to prolonged use. The special mosaic nail embedded in the handle makes the knife more beautiful more stylish.

√【LIFETIME WARRANTY】 WALLOP promise a superior product that will give you a lifetime of exemplary service against defects in material and workmanship.Try it risk free, you'll love it! With the luxury packing, it is also the wise choice as a gift.
